geographicDefinition.name: Dallas–Fort Worth–Arlington metropolitan statistical area
geographicDefinition.method: TEA districtCounty is administrative district county-of-record proxy, not parcel or campus coordinate.
geographicDefinition.caveat: This is a full census of district IDs present in the current TEA snapshot for the 11 named counties, NOT a certified list of every school district serving parcels across county lines. Unobserved ISDs, cross-county attendance and omitted campuses require source reconciliation.
geographicDefinition.extendedRegion: NCTCOG 12-county region additionally includes Hood. Hood is absent from the present TEA snapshot and cannot be counted as zero districts.

definitions.parentGuidanceRate: ISDs with already recorded, allowlisted official parent entry page; not a tested live address-grade lookup success rate.
definitions.campusPolygonCoverage: Unknown DFW-wide: reference minima exist only for seven previously audited district mappings. Do not use 0% for unreviewed districts.
definitions.specificCampusMissingReason: A district-level data gap is not proof a particular campus lacks a zone; per-campus root causes require browser/source audit.
definitions.otherLEAs: Non-ISD names may be charter, alternative, multi-campus LEA or special authority; classify enrollment rules independently.
